sim.stage.open.description: Open a USD file (.usd/.usda/.usdc/.usdz under your home) as the current stage, like File > Open, with the timeline stopped. Refuses when the current stage really has unsaved edits unless discard_changes=true. Deactivates stale saved LiDAR render products in the session layer so their ROS topics return (reported in stale_render_products; the file is unchanged). Returns the new session_id/stage_id for later sim__* calls; run_python sessions reset. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

discard_changes.description: Open even if the current stage has unsaved edits (they are lost).

sim.timeline.control.description: Explicit play, pause or stop. Stop rewinds physics and awaits pending native render/writer completion, including writer finalization and capture-settings restoration. The five-second timeout is cooperative, not a hard deadline for native calls. Play only observes a pending Stop; TIMELINE_BUSY or TIMELINE_INTERRUPTED requires inspection and explicit retry, never automatic replay. Leases the session edit target for physics writeback and restores it on Stop. Never pumps the Kit update loop; exact stepping uses sim.simulation.step. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

sim.stage.save.description: Export a flattened copy, including session edits, to a new basename (.usda is added if absent) in the configured output root, or in `directory` (an existing folder under your home, e.g. a lab work folder). Never overwrite or switch the current stage. Paused Newton copies runtime rigid-body poses into the export only (<=256 bodies), not a solver checkpoint. External texture paths remain dependencies. Process-bound SyntheticData pipelines and pack render products are omitted from the copy; cameras, LiDAR definitions and user graphs remain. Unknown native pipeline content refuses save. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

reset_camera_render_handles.description: Explicitly remove validated session-only ROS camera and LiDAR viewportHandle fields from the copy so native textures can rebuild after restart. This tool's own capture products need no flag. Default false refuses affected saves; true still refuses authored, ambiguous, connected or unavailable bindings. Originals and live stage are unchanged; omitted property paths are returned. This is export policy, not proof of authorship.

sim.viewport.frame.description: Point the active viewport camera. path alone: Kit's native select-and-frame. path+margin: frame the prim's current bounds plus margin metres, keeping the view direction. eye+target (world, stage units): place the camera exactly; with path, target defaults to the prim's centre. If the prim has no geometry, an unambiguous nearby subtree can be selected; the result reports the requested and actual paths, and follow tracks the actual path. follow=false stops following; it also stops on stage change, camera switch or a new call. Edits only the active camera in the session layer; no Kit undo entry. Refuses look-through targets, unsafe session-sublayer camera opinions and empty bounds (with candidates). Does not wait for rendered pixels; then screenshot the app window or record. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

sim.prim.delete.description: Delete one pack-owned subtree from the session layer only. Requires stopped physics and confirm=true; exact owned sensors release their resources; sensor-containing subtrees and articulation roots are refused. Prims from an opened file are not pack-owned, even ones you made earlier: allow_foreign=true deactivates such a prim in the session layer instead (USD cannot remove another layer's opinions from there). It stays composed as inactive and keeps its path; a sim__stage__save copy omits it; source files never change. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

sim.graph.build.description: Create a whole OmniGraph (e.g. an Action Graph for ROS 2) in one call: nodes, input values, connections and prim targets. Containers or individual node/connection entries may be JSON-encoded strings; flat alternating node and connection lists also work. Checks every port against the created nodes and lists the real ports on a typo; creates Make Array-style inputs (inputs:input1, ...) itself; stores a token's value when given its key (Scale To/From Stage Units: 'toStage' -> 'Convert to stage units'); sets prim targets (e.g. an Articulation Controller's inputs:targetPrim) as USD relationships. Timeline stopped. Rolls the graph back on any error; returns it as sim__graph__inspect does. Find node types and ports first with sim__graph__node_types. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.
